ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.3 Lean Live V2
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Evidence-curated D.2.3 baseline for RimWorld 1.5. The DLL is built from an explicit production whitelist. It removes the low-yield T34 fabrics, worker scheduler, frame dispatcher, tick sampler, worker haul index, Clean Pathfinding hooks and all validator, reachability and reservation replay. It retains the measured synchronous S4/S5, DoBill, Common Sense, merge and text-cache paths. Final gameplay decisions execute live on the main thread.
